text:
Can you write an email to people who didn't renew their farm share? I run a 30-acre vegetable farm and sell 22-week shares that people pick up every Thursday.

Facts:
- Last year 260 households had a share. 97 didn't renew.
- On July 9 a hailstorm destroyed about half our crops. For the next 6 weeks the boxes had about half the usual amount. We didn't offer refunds or credit, and I sent one short email about it.
- A full share is $540 this year, the same as last year.
- This year we've added a second field on higher ground and put up 2 hail nets over our tomatoes and peppers. That cost $31,000.
- Members can now pause up to 2 weeks and get credit for them.
- Sign-up closes March 15. 52 shares are left.

Under 200 words.

<final_document>
Subject: What we changed after last summer's hail

Hi [First name],

You didn't renew your share this year, and I think I know why.

On July 9, a hailstorm destroyed about half our crops. For the next six weeks, your boxes had about half the usual amount. We didn't offer refunds or credit, and I sent only one short email about it. That wasn't good enough. You paid for full boxes, and you deserved a clear explanation and a better response from me.

Here's what we've changed:

- **A second field on higher ground**, so our crops aren't all in one place.
- **Two hail nets** over our tomatoes and peppers.
- **Pause credits:** you can now pause up to two weeks and get credit for them.

The new field and nets cost us $31,000. A full share is still $540, the same as last year, with pickup every Thursday for 22 weeks.

Sign-up closes March 15, and 52 shares are left. If you'd like to come back, you can sign up here: [link]

If you'd rather tell me what would bring you back, just reply to this email.

Thank you for the seasons you spent with us.

[Your name]
[Farm name]
</final_document>

The email is about 190 words. It says plainly what went wrong and owns how you handled it. I left it to the facts you gave me. It doesn't promise the nets will stop hail damage, and it doesn't say why the higher field helps. If there's a real reason you can state, like better drainage or a different storm track, adding one line about it would make that point stronger. Before sending, fill in the name merge field, the sign-up link and your signature.
